case.summary: The investigation concluded that transaction 3514948 was an authorized cardholder purchase and not a compromise. Review of the transaction showed it fell within the customer’s typical spend range, originated from the card’s known device fingerprint, and the cardholder confirmed the purchase during outreach; no linked cards or suspicious patterns were identified. Accordingly, the case has been cleared and closed under policy CLOSE_NO_FRAUD, with the card remaining active and no further action required.
